notes.title: CODE: PANDORA 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Friends, fans — and yes, even haters.

While we're still preparing the remake of Witch 1, I’m excited to present the next chapter: CODE: Pandora.
Originally, the Absolute Weapon was supposed to be just a DLC for the first game — a small side adventure on a unique planet. But, as fate would have it, DLC development dragged on, and content kept piling up. So, with the iron will of the Dark Lord — and a random push of the launch button by our resident Goblin — it was decided: this story deserved a full sequel.

What’s different this time?
The biggest change: we’re no longer limited to a single planet. Now, your adventures will take you across nine worlds, with your headquarters stationed on the intergalactic base Ghost-5. From there, you’ll be contacting the lords of the Pandora galaxy, and your ultimate goal will be to piece together the full coordinates of the shadow planet where the Absolute Weapon is hidden.

There’s more — for the first time, Driply won’t be the only playable character. You’ll be joined by Lika, who, unlike diplomatic Driply, specializes in sabotage. But the choice is yours: plot daring sabotage missions, or befriend everyone in sight — it’s all up to you.

In the end, whether you get the coordinates by force, by cunning, or by friendship, the adventure will be yours to shape.

Thank you all for supporting the games and the Pandora universe — just as you did with Witch.

With love and respect,
Elbaf45
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3758430/KOD_PANDORA_2/?curator_clanid=34719194

notes.title: CANDLE DAEMON on Linux + SteamOS
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Yes, I continue to adapt to the steam deck. This time CANDLE DAEMON.
A build of the game for Linux has been uploaded to the server. (builds for ubuntu and manjaro)
So launch of the game on the steam deck was successful
In the meantime until Valve officially checked compatibility you can set the compatibility in the steam deck settings to Steam Linux Runtime 1.0
The controller should also be set to Keyboard + mouse. If you click on the controller icon, go to Community Layouts and you can download the keyboard (WASD) layout (Steam deck compatible) by 
Elbaf45 WASD candle daemon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763112/48ab4e813cc1110fd00ffae3bc207f24779ff210.png[/img]
Go to special settings and set the checkbox to steam deck. This way the control hints will be synchronized with your steam deck
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763112/9d3d0f785d173acf5bc9bcd44029606847be7aee.png[/img]
And of course a little about future games
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2731300/_4/
Thank you all! See you later!

notes.title: Candle Daemon
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
So Candle Daemon is available for purchase. The events of the game take place just before the beginning of the second part of The Witch. The ending of the game is somewhat different, so as not to watch the final video, which is essentially the beginning for the second part of the witch, help Agnet or Lilith or both of them find the obelisks and parts of the necklace.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763112/06e22274a83140cda60bdc1bec513a7ed14e6e6e.jpg[/img]
As I said earlier, the game has RPG elements. But for everyone who just wants to watch pictures, there is a special “Immortality” mode. It turns on at any time with all saves. The only thing is that it needs to be installed every time you start the game again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763112/e9abc15eef0957a379125c501e6147cd8a1a787c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763112/1b776e3b3fa0ae3751a685c4a28bedafbbe28adf.jpg[/img]
Have a good game!
